title: Inertial smooth scroll
summary: Scroll is taken over by a smoothing library, so the page glides with momentum. It sets the pacing for every other scroll effect.
use_when: Scroll-choreographed pages with pinned or scrubbed sections.
avoid_when: Docs and long reading pages; hijacked scroll annoys readers.
recipe:
// Lenis (or similar), tuned gently; honor reduced motion
if (!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1 });
specimen_html:
native wheel · jumps per notch
smoothed (lerp 0.1) · glides with momentum
